title: Buffalo Chicken Wraps
shortDescription: Shredded buffalo chicken with lettuce and ranch in flour tortillas
subtitle: Shredded buffalo chicken with lettuce and ranch in flour tortillas
description: Chicken thighs are simmered, shredded, and tossed in buttery buffalo sauce, then rolled with crisp lettuce and ranch or blue cheese in flour tortillas. Halved wraps show orange buffalo chicken and green lettuce — not a generic chicken wrap.

steps.title: Poach and shred chicken
steps.instruction: Simmer thighs in broth until 165°F, about 18–20 minutes. Transfer to a board, shred with forks while warm, and discard poaching liquid. Shredded meat absorbs buffalo sauce better than cubed breast. Scale poaching batches for 4, 6, 8, 10, or 14 firefighters using the crew scaler.

steps.title: Make buffalo sauce
steps.instruction: Melt butter in a saucepan, whisk in hot sauce, and simmer 2 minutes. Toss shredded chicken with enough sauce to coat well — there should be visible orange coating on every strand.

steps.title: Prep lettuce and warm tortillas
steps.instruction: Shred lettuce and chill until rolling. Warm tortillas briefly so they flex without tearing when you pack buffalo chicken and lettuce.

steps.title: Roll and halve
steps.instruction: Layer buffalo chicken and lettuce on each tortilla. Drizzle ranch inside or serve on the side. Roll tight, slice in half on a bias, and expose the cut face up on the tray so buffalo chicken and lettuce are obvious.

steps.title: Serve with dressing and celery
steps.instruction: Pass ranch or blue cheese and celery at the line. Hold foiled halves at 200°F up to 15 minutes — refresh cut face with a spoon of sauce if a call delays service.

proTips: A teaspoon of honey in the sauce rounds heat without killing spice.
Do not confuse this with buffalo dip — wraps need less sauce per bite or they leak.
Gloves help when tossing hot buffalo chicken at volume.
tonightSpread: Extra hot sauce for heat seekers
leftovers: Buffalo chicken on pizza night flatbreads
whyCrewsLikeIt: Buffalo dip is already on the game-day roster; wraps give the same flavour without chips-only vibes. Thighs stay juicy when held, and the crew picks ranch or blue cheese like they would at wing night.
mealPrepNotes: Shred chicken while warm for clean pulls. Keep buffalo sauce warm in a small pot. Roll just before the line or cut in half and wrap cut ends in foil. Hold halved wraps cut-side up on sheet pans at 200°F up to 15 minutes.
